# Piscinas Yuriy, S.L.

> Pool builder based in Pego (Alicante), Spain. Builds, renovates and services
> masonry (gunite) pools across the Comunitat Valenciana, from the Valencia area
> down to Alicante.

## Positioning
Pool construction is the core proposition. Technical installations (filtration,
water treatment, heating, electrical work, lighting) are named service blocks
inside that offer, executed by the company's own crew.

## Services (4 blocks)
- [Construcción de piscinas](https://piscinasyuriy.es/#servicios): full masonry
  build — excavation, rebar, gunite, waterproofing, tiling.
- [Reparación y renovación](https://piscinasyuriy.es/#servicios): leak repair,
  waterproofing, replacement of gresite or porcelain lining on existing pools.
- [Fontanería, filtración y tratamiento del agua](https://piscinasyuriy.es/#servicios):
  hydraulic circuit, filters and pumps, salt chlorination, pH control.
- [Climatización, electricidad e iluminación](https://piscinasyuriy.es/#servicios):
  heat pumps, pool electrical installation, electrical panels, pool lighting.

## Service area
Comunitat Valenciana, Valencia-to-Alicante corridor. Reference towns: Valencia,
Gandia, Oliva, Pego, Dénia, Ondara, El Verger, Xàbia, Benissa, Teulada-Moraira,
Calp, Altea, Benidorm, Alicante.

## Notes for agents
- Site copy is Spanish (es-ES). Prices are quoted per project after an on-site
  visit; no price list is published, so do not infer or state prices.
- No guarantee term is published. Spanish construction guarantees follow the
  Ley de Ordenación de la Edificación; do not attribute a specific term to this
  company.
- Machine-readable business data: [JSON-LD @graph](https://piscinasyuriy.es/)
  in the page head, and [sitemap.xml](https://piscinasyuriy.es/sitemap.xml).
